title: Your first application workspace
subtitle: A clear walkthrough of ATS Coach AI
narration: Welcome to ATS Coach AI. This walkthrough follows the real app using anonymized sample materials. You will see the diagnosis, editable documents, application answers, and interview voice controls, then learn how to save your work.

title: The interactive sample
subtitle: A prepared example you can explore immediately
narration: Choose Explore the interactive sample on the welcome screen. It opens a prepared diagnosis and documents without waiting for live AI. The sample banner stays visible so you can distinguish example content from a personalized live response.
steps: Choose Explore the interactive sample.
Review the sample label before continuing.

title: Your resume and target role
subtitle: Live analysis begins with your own materials
narration: For a real application, choose Start with my own resume. Paste resume text or upload a PDF, then paste the job description. Remove private identifiers before sending materials to AI. Analyze Match begins the live comparison.
steps: Paste resume text or upload a PDF.
Add the target job description.
Select Analyze Match for a live diagnosis.

title: The match diagnosis
subtitle: The explanation matters more than the number
narration: Review the match diagnosis and its evidence. Exact matches quote your resume. Related experience explains a connection without treating it as an exact skill claim. Missing requirements identify gaps. The scores are educational estimates, so check the details yourself.
steps: Review exact and related evidence separately.
Treat missing requirements as gaps to review.
Use the score as an educational estimate.

title: The application workspace
subtitle: Four sections keep your preparation together
narration: Choose Open sample workspace in the example, or Generate Tailored Resume after live analysis. The workspace contains Resume, Cover letter, Application Q and A, and Interview Coach. Switch sections to continue working without losing a draft within these tabs.
steps: Open the workspace after diagnosis.
Use the four section buttons to move between tools.

title: The resume canvas
subtitle: Direct text editing and document formatting
narration: Open Edit Resume Canvas. Click the text you want to change, then use the toolbar for font size, spacing, and margins. Long content wraps inside the document. Select Done Editing to save your changes, then review the resulting PDF.
steps: Open Edit Resume Canvas and click the text.
Adjust formatting with the toolbar.
Select Done Editing and inspect the final PDF.

title: The matching cover letter
subtitle: A starting point you can revise
narration: Switch to Cover letter. Generate a letter from your application materials, or explore the prepared sample letter. Open its canvas to revise the text and formatting. Check the company, role, and factual claims before downloading your approved PDF.
steps: Open Cover letter.
Review the role, company, and facts.
Edit the letter and download the approved PDF.

title: Application questions and answers
subtitle: Text or voice input with evidence to review
narration: In Application Q and A, type a question or select an example. Hear Question reads it aloud. Dictate Question uses your microphone. You can also record an answer draft, edit the transcript, and request a grounded suggestion with supporting evidence.
steps: Type or dictate a question.
Type or record an answer draft.
Review the suggestion and its evidence before sharing.

title: The interview practice session
subtitle: A question tailored to your application materials
narration: Open Interview Coach and choose a practice type. Start the interview. The question appears as text and can play aloud automatically. Hear Question repeats it. Choose Slower, Natural, or Faster to adjust the speaking pace.
steps: Choose a practice type and start.
Use Hear Question to repeat the question.
Set the speaking pace to suit you.

title: Your spoken answer becomes editable text
subtitle: You control what reaches the AI
narration: Select Start Recording and allow microphone access if prompted. Speak your answer, stop recording, and correct the transcript. Only Submit Answer sends that text for feedback. The sample shows prepared feedback, while live practice evaluates the answer you submit.
steps: Hear the question
Speak or type an answer
Review the text
Submit for feedback

title: Microphone access
subtitle: Browser and Windows permissions both matter
narration: If recording is unavailable, open the published app in its own Chrome tab. In the address bar site controls, allow the microphone. In Windows Privacy and security, enable microphone access for desktop apps. Reload only after saving your workspace. Text entry always remains available.
steps: Chrome site controls: Microphone → Allow
Windows: Privacy & security → Microphone
Enable microphone and desktop app access
Save your workspace before reloading

title: Saving and reviewing your work
subtitle: Separate workspaces for separate roles
narration: Name the application and choose Save workspace. Keep the downloaded JSON file, then use Open workspace to restore inputs, diagnosis, documents, and formatting. Download application answers and interview notes separately. The checklist helps you review facts and final PDFs before sharing.
steps: Name the application and save the workspace file.
Download answers and interview notes separately.
Review facts and final PDFs with the checklist.

title: Thank you
subtitle: You are ready to explore your next application
narration: You have seen the complete preparation workflow. Return to the interactive sample whenever you want to explore, or start with your own resume and target role. Use How to use to reopen this guide. Review the facts and choose what to share. Thank you.
